name: OpenAI Presence
desc: OpenAI’s product for putting voice and chat agents into customer workflows.
desc_zh: OpenAI 把语音和对话 Agent 放进客服与内部流程的产品。
solves: Rolling out a support agent means assembling the stack yourself. Presence packages the voice and chat agent, with the controls a launch needs.
solves_zh: 上线一个客服 Agent 过去得自己拼整套技术栈。Presence 把语音和对话 Agent 连同上线所需的控制项一起打包。
best_for: You are putting an agent in front of customers and need it to hold up in production.
best_for_zh: 你要把 Agent 放到客户面前，并需要它在生产环境里站得住。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — OpenAI news, https://openai.com/index/introducing-openai-presence）。 Enterprise-facing. The announcement page states availability for voice and chat agents on the day of publication. 首次公开日期来源：https://openai.com/index/introducing-openai-presence
